notes: I replaced the sin(x/30) model with an odd-ish form `0.9*sin(x/18) + 0.015*x`: the evidence shows large positive x mostly gives positive y and large negative x mostly gives negative y (a sign(x) trend), which the old model lacked, plus a faster oscillation period (~2π·18≈113) that better matches the sign flips seen across the probes.
